reason: The README describes a plugin for launching temporary, isolated child-agent conversations through a floating interface, with broad tool access and temporary workspace cleanup; its primary purpose is agent orchestration.

summaries.zh: 通过可拖动的浮窗创建与父会话隔离的临时子 Agent 会话，并在关闭时清理其临时工作目录。
summaries.en: Creates temporary child-agent sessions in a draggable floating window, isolated from the parent conversation and cleaned up on close.

capabilities: Creates temporary child-agent sessions isolated from the parent conversation
Provides the child agent with shell, file, background-task, workflow, subagent, and web-fetch tools
Creates and removes dedicated temporary session directories
Adds a draggable floating-window interface and RPC endpoints for opening, sending, polling, and closing sessions
